title: Miao Miao 2 (FSL 14days eu) and xdrip+
body:
Dear all,

Proud owner of a miao miao 2. I am encountering some problems, such as others.
Many topics have been opened, but none were properly closed or answered.

Miao miao 2 is working with the application tomato, meaning the sensor and miao miao 2 is working. While activating the miao miao 2 in xdrip+, with connection status "connected" in "systeem status", i still receive no input while "collecting initial readings". Data collector running is green. It gets stuck on receiving data from LimiTTer collector.

What is going on here? 

ps. reinstalling doesnt work either.

Feedback is much appreciated, thanks!

Hello Stug,

Same issue yesterday but i discovered that my Xdrip+ version was not the lastest ( "Lastest version on website is 20190518, quite "old")

I have switched to 20190930-7d97b62.apk and now, as soon as the collector change to LimiTTER to Tomato, everything run fine.

Try it :)

Cheers!

Cheers! Worked like a charm. Thanks for the heads-up. I was sure I had the latest alpha version, but appearantly i did not. Everything working like a charm right now!

problem solved?
Have new freestyle libre 2 sensor and miaomiao2 - can't make work with xdrip+
Same setup works fine with libre 1 sensor.

@Stuggesjoerd Can we close this issue as it seems your problem was resolved?
Thanks

the same problem for me
FSL2 europe+bubble mini+xdrip
it connect to bubble mini, but no data transfert. i have a message speaking about OOP2 sometimes.
but perhaps xdrip does not works with freestyle libre 2 sensor. i don't know. my phone does not support NFC, and does not support librelink.

One way to work around this problems is using oop2. See
https://www.minimallooper.com/post/how-to-setup-freestyle-libre-2-and-oop2-to-use-a-native-bluetooth-connection-in-xdrip
for more info.
